subject: Web Development
title: Web Bluetooth and Hardware APIs
description: One-minute skill: Web Bluetooth and Hardware APIs.

hook.text: Browsers can now connect to Bluetooth devices, USB peripherals, and serial ports.

buildup.text: Web Bluetooth lets a web page talk to fitness trackers, smart lights, and IoT sensors.

discovery.text: WebUSB and WebSerial connect browsers to Arduino boards and lab equipment without native apps.

twist.text: These APIs raise security concerns. A malicious site could try to access connected devices.

climax.text: Hardware APIs turn the browser from a document viewer into an operating system for the real world.

punchline.text: The browser can now talk to your devices.

quiz.question: What does Web Bluetooth allow?
options: Connecting to Bluetooth devices from a browser
